name: Detect Changes
on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      code_changed:
        description: 'Whether code files changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.code_changed }}
      test_changed:
        description: 'Whether test files changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.test_changed }}
      dependency_changed:
        description: 'Whether dependency files changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.dependency_changed }}
      content_changed:
        description: 'Whether content files changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.content_changed }}
      seo_changed:
        description: 'Whether SEO files changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.seo_changed }}
      all_changed:
        description: 'Whether any relevant files changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.all_changed }}

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Detect changed files
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            code:
              - '**/*.ts'
              - '**/*.tsx'
              - '**/*.js'
              - '**/*.jsx'
            tests:
              - '**/__tests__/**'
              - '**/*.test.ts'
              - '**/*.test.tsx'
              - '**/*.spec.ts'
              - '**/*.spec.tsx'
            dependencies:
              - 'package.json'
              - 'package-lock.json'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'yarn.lock'
            content:
              - 'content/**'
              - 'docs/**'
            seo:
              - 'src/seo/**'
              - 'public/seo/**'

      - name: Set outputs
        run: |
          echo "code_changed=${{ steps.filter.outputs.code }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "test_changed=${{ steps.filter.outputs.tests }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "dependency_changed=${{ steps.filter.outputs.dependencies }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "content_changed=${{ steps.filter.outputs.content }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "seo_changed=${{ steps.filter.outputs.seo }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [[ "${{ steps.filter.outputs.code }}" == "true" || "${{ steps.filter.outputs.tests }}" == "true" || "${{ steps.filter.outputs.dependencies }}" == "true" || "${{ steps.filter.outputs.content }}" == "true" || "${{ steps.filter.outputs.seo }}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "all_changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "all_changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
